findings.title: Rust compiler executable identity is not captured
findings.detail: binary_fingerprints requires hashes for kani_driver, kani_compiler, and cbmc, but it does not hash the rustc executable used by the Kani compiler. The rustc_version_record and release_manifest candidates point to target/kani/rustc-version and target/kani/rust-toolchain-version, which are written only by build-kani's bundle_kani path; the workflow instead runs cargo build-dev, whose BuildDev branch only invokes build_bin/build_lib. Those files will therefore be absent and be recorded with null hashes. Export tools.rustc is only a version string. Consequently the requested exact compiler/binary provenance is incomplete even though Kani driver/compiler, CBMC, toolchain config, and exported target/version are observed.
findings.recommended_fix: During CI-only fingerprinting, resolve rustc from the toolchain pinned by rust-toolchain.toml, hash that executable, and make its presence mandatory for an accepted observation; retain the existing Kani driver/compiler and CBMC hashes and target/version fields.
